For further details contact us at https://mythospedals.com/pages/contact It was just a matter of time Inspired by the most iconic pedal of all time Tweaked just right The Envy Pro Overdrive is inspired by the various versions of that ever polarizing green stompbox. We aren't trying to reinvent the wheel, but give you the best that this circuit has to offer. With its increased output, expanded drive range, and thickened low end, the Envy takes the TS formula and makes it more useful for every player, regardless of style. Push it real good We wanted to give the Envy more options than just 3 knobs and decided on something fun and slightly different - push buttons! The Lows and Clip buttons offer quick adjustments of the circuits most oft tweaked parameters. With the buttons up the circuit is a more traditional voiced TS style drive. With Lows engaged you increase the amount of low end for a fuller overall sound. When the Clip button is pushed the diodes are disengaged for a louder, less compressed, more open sound. Through Hole Heart At the core of the Envy Pro Overdrive is a socketed RC4558P Dual Op Amp chip. We did this for one very important reason, experimentation. Zach has said on many occasions that Dual Op Amps don't sound all that different but if you want to experiment with different chips you can do that in the Envy pretty painlessly. RC4558, JRC4558, TL072, OP275, OPA2604, LM1458N the list goes on! Envy Pro Overdrive Controls Level - Adjusts the Output Tone - Classic TS Style Tone Circuit Drive - Adjust the amount of Overdrive Push Switches Lows - Classic Low End (When Up), Increased Low End (When Pushed Down) Clip - Stock TS Soft Clipping (When Up), Diode Lift (When Pushed Down) Recommended Settings Flooding in Texas Grab your Strat and crank it Nice 'N Thick Push the Lows and take a solo There Is No Plan B Push the Lows and Clip for that signature RS sound. While not straying too far from what makes that original design so magical, the Envy expands the range of the controls and offers players more flexibility in getting their own sound. The Level control has been tuned for better output while the Drive control has been altered to allow for less gain at minimum and more gain at maximum. The voicing of the unit has been tuned for a slightly fuller tone. What makes the Envy so special are the two Push Buttons, a first for Mythos. When in the up position, it’s the classic TS style sound. Engaging the LOWS push button allows you fatten up the low end for a more even sound that’s slightly less mid forward. With the CLIP button in the up position, it’s the stock Silicon Soft Clipping we all know, but when you push the button in it removes the diodes from the circuit.
